what_works: Beige and warm-gray foundation punctuated by deep-green and marble-black jewel accents — luxury without serif clichés. Architectural close-ups (marble, leather, wood) photographed in natural light as compositional anchors, not lifestyle staging.
what_does_not_translate: Premium architecture-firm portfolio expects gallery-grade photography; for a contractor, the move is the warm-neutral palette with one jewel accent, plus material close-ups in real light (no studio strobe).
type_observations: Clean contemporary sans-serif with editorial spacing. Hierarchy through scale and whitespace, never weight contrast or color.
